description.zh: 连接后可创建/编辑数据表与列，批量增删改查行数据，公式列自动计算，上传附件，查询账户套餐与团队成员。需账户开通新版表格。
description.en: Once connected, create/edit tables and columns, batch add/query/update/delete rows, use formula columns, upload attachments, and check plan quota and team members. Requires the new Tables feature enabled on the account.
